declaration.basis: Current hierarchical 02-power-usb schematic and saved-board native pins: FB1 output to U6 IN2 (pin 2), with existing C9/C52/C53 bypass leaves. The unchanged 0.75 A conductor basis applies to the aggregate path, not separately to each capacitor or USB-C pin. No mux clamp, inrush, barrel or release qualification follows.

Current hierarchical 02-power-usb schematic and saved-board native pins: F1 output to FB1 input. The existing service-chain current and margin are unchanged; component hold/trip/current ratings are not substituted for a load or fault-current bound.

Current hierarchical 02-power-usb schematic and saved-board native pins: USB-C VBUS bank to F1 input. Uses only the pre-existing 0.75 A service-chain conductor basis and its once-applied 125 percent geometry margin; no fuse clamp, equal pin sharing, barrel, inrush, thermal or release qualification is inferred.

Owner-authorized 1 A sustained negative-12-volt pass-through design basis, 2026-10-17: actual J3 pin 14 to J_SIG1 pin 1. The existing 125 percent conductor geometry margin applies once to the complete path. C22, C23 and R75 are local bypass/divider leaves, not alternate full-current sinks or a basis for reducing the pass-through load. This is not a measured load, PSU source guarantee, connector/barrel capacity, inrush, thermal or release qualification.

findings.message: CAD proves R59=43200 ohm and R69=10000 ohm on OV1; TPS2121 rising trip is 5.639 V nominal and 5.287 to 5.948 V at specified extremes; only 52 mV remains to the 6.0 V absolute maximum, so transient overshoot and trip delay still require analysis and bench validation

USB2 sink ingress exposes 20.100 uF nominal (C52, C53, C9) through passive links F1, FB1 before active current limiting; exceeds the 10 uF hard-attach screening budget. Qualify effective capacitance and hot-plug inrush; downstream mux soft-start is not input-cap protection. Source: TI SLVA129, https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/slva129
